traditions.KJV: and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah ,

12.english_reference: and found him by the great waters that [ are ] in Gibeon .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּמְצְא֣וּ אֹת֔ וֹ אֶל מַ֥יִם רַבִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ גִבְעֽוֹן

traditions.VUL: et invenérunt eum ad aquas multas , quæ sunt in Gábaon .
traditions.KJV: and found him by the great waters that [ are ] in Gibeon .

13.english_reference: Now it came to pass , [ that ] when all the people which [ were ] with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces that [ were ] with him ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֗י כִּ רְא֤וֹת כָּל הָ עָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶת יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל אֶת יֽוֹחָנָן֙ בֶּן קָרֵ֔חַ וְ אֵ֛ת כָּל שָׂרֵ֥י הַ חֲיָלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε εἶδεν πᾶς ὁ λαός ὁ μετὰ Ἰσμαὴλ τὸν Ἰωανὰν καὶ τοὺς ἡγεμόνας τῆς δυνάμεως τῆς μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׂמָֽחוּ
traditions.VUL: lætáti sunt .
traditions.KJV: then they were glad .

14.english_reference: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּסֹ֨בּוּ֙ כָּל הָ עָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר שָׁבָ֥ה יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל מִן הַ מִּצְפָּ֑ה וַ יָּשֻׁ֨בוּ֙

traditions.KJV: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned ,

14.english_reference: and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah .

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֣לְכ֔וּ אֶל יֽוֹחָנָ֖ן בֶּן קָרֵֽחַ

traditions.VUL: ábiit ad Ióhanan fílium Carée .
traditions.KJV: and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah .

15.english_reference: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men ,

traditions.WLC: וְ יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן נְתַנְיָ֗ה נִמְלַט֙ בִּ שְׁמֹנָ֣ה אֲנָשִׁ֔ים מִ פְּנֵ֖י יֽוֹחָנָ֑ן

traditions.KJV: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֖לֶךְ אֶל בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ᾤχετο πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἀμμών .
traditions.VUL: et ábiit ad fílios Ammon .
traditions.KJV: and went to the Ammonites .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקַּח֩ יוֹחָנָ֨ן בֶּן קָרֵ֜חַ וְ כָל שָׂרֵ֧י הַ חֲיָלִ֣ים אֲשֶׁר אִתּ֗ וֹ אֵ֣ת כָּל שְׁאֵרִ֤ית הָ עָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵ֠שִׁיב מֵ אֵ֨ת יִשְׁמָעֵ֤אל בֶּן נְתַנְיָה֙ מִן הַ מִּצְפָּ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ἰωανὰν καὶ πάντες οἱ ἡγεμόνες τῆς δυνάμεως οἱ μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ πάντας τοὺς καταλοίπους τοῦ λαοῦ οὓς ἀπέστρεψεν ἀπὸ Ἰσμαήλ ,
traditions.VUL: Tulit ergo Ióhanan fílius Carée , et omnes príncipes bellatórum , qui erant cum eo , univérsas relíquias vulgi , quas redúxerat ab Ismahel fílio Nathaníæ de Masphath ,
traditions.KJV: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces that [ were ] with him , all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , from Mizpah ,

16.english_reference: after [ that ] he had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam ,

traditions.WLC: אַחַ֣ר הִכָּ֔ה אֶת גְּדַלְיָ֖ה בֶּן אֲחִיקָ֑ם
traditions.VUL: postquam percússit Godolíam fílium Ahicam :
traditions.KJV: after [ that ] he had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam , [ even ]

traditions.LXX: δυνατοὺς ἄνδρας ἐν πολέμῳ , καὶ τὰς γυναῖκας καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ καὶ τοὺς εὐνούχους

traditions.KJV: mighty men of war , and the women , and the children , and the eunuchs ,

16.english_reference: whom he had brought again from Gibeon :

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵשִׁ֖יב מִ גִּבְעֽוֹן
traditions.LXX: οὓς ἀπέστρεψεν ἀπὸ Γαβαών ,
traditions.VUL: quos redúxerat de Gábaon .
traditions.KJV: whom he had brought again from Gibeon :

traditions.LXX: καὶ ᾤχοντο καὶ ἐκάθισαν ἐν Γαβηρωχαμάα τὴν πρὸς Βηθλέεμ ,
traditions.VUL: Et abiérunt , et sedérunt peregrinántes in Chámaam , quæ est iuxta Béthlehem ,
traditions.KJV: And they departed , and dwelt in the habitation of Chimham , which is by Bethlehem ,

17.english_reference: to go to enter into Egypt ,

traditions.WLC: לָ לֶ֖כֶת לָ ב֥וֹא מִצְרָֽיִם
traditions.LXX: τοῦ πορευθῆναι εἰς Αἴγυπτον .
traditions.VUL: ut pérgerent , et introírent Ægýptum
traditions.KJV: to go to enter into Egypt ,

traditions.VUL: timébant enim eos ,
traditions.KJV: for they were afraid of them ,

traditions.KJV: because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam ,
